core: Epithelial apical-basal polarity and cell-cell adhesion
qualifier: including podocyte nephrin interactions and cortical microtubules
name: Epithelial polarity and adhesion including podocyte nephrin
rationale: All members concern establishing/maintaining epithelial apical-basal polarity and cell-cell adhesion; unlike the adherens-junction/apical-junction confusables, the theme adds podocyte nephrin interactions, podocyte migration and cortical microtubule organization.

qualifier: with intestinal lipid absorption and chylomicron/VLDL assembly
name: Dietary lipid absorption and plasma lipoprotein remodeling and clearance
rationale: Members cover intestinal lipid digestion/absorption and chylomicron, VLDL, LDL and HDL assembly, remodeling and clearance, distinguishing it from confusables centred on HDL assembly/cholesterol efflux, vitamin E/sterol transport or triglyceride catabolism.

core: Neuronal calcium entry and intercellular signaling
qualifier: gap junction transmission and Gi-coupled glutamate receptor
name: Neuronal calcium entry, gap junction and Gi-coupled glutamate signaling
rationale: Members regulate neuronal/glial calcium influx and cell-cell signaling, combining gap-junction electrical transmission and adenylate-cyclase-inhibiting mGluR signaling, which separates it from connexin-assembly, presynaptic-inhibition and cAMP-regulation confusables.

core: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in gland branching morphogenesis
qualifier: prostate and salivary gland
name: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in prostate and salivary gland branching
rationale: Members describe reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signaling driving branching, budding and epithelial differentiation in prostate and salivary glands (plus limb bud), distinct from lung-mesenchyme, pancreatic/kidney and genital-tract confusables.

qualifier: BAX/BAK pore formation, apoptosome caspase activation and SMAC-IAP relief
name: BAX/BAK pore formation, apoptosome caspase activation and IAP relief
rationale: All members are the downstream effector steps of intrinsic apoptosis (BAX/BAK oligomerization, release of cytochrome c/SMAC, apoptosome caspase activation, SMAC neutralization of IAPs), whereas confusables centre on BH3-only activation and regulation of MOMP.

qualifier: PINK1-Parkin and receptor-mediated, triggered by mitochondrial depolarization
name: PINK1-Parkin and receptor-mediated mitophagy after depolarization
rationale: Members concern removal of depolarized mitochondria by PINK1-Parkin and receptor-mediated mitophagy and cargo delivery to autophagosomes, unlike confusables about mitochondrial fission/fusion and protein import or pexophagy and general autophagosome regulation.

qualifier: enterohepatic transport, secretion and signaling-based feedback
name: Bile acid enterohepatic transport, signaling and synthesis regulation
rationale: Members cover bile acid recycling, BSEP-mediated secretion, transport, receptor signaling and feedback regulation of synthesis, distinguishing it from confusables focused on de novo bile acid synthesis routes or ABC xenobiotic/lipid transport.

Three members are PAX3 target/motif gene sets while the other two are unrelated Reactome transcriptional programmes (ALK-driven nuclear events in cancer and PTEN gene transcription), so no single biological theme is true of all members.

core: Blood pressure lowering by cGMP signaling
qualifier: natriuretic peptide-driven natriuresis and vasodilation
name: Natriuretic peptide-cGMP blood pressure lowering and natriuresis
rationale: Members concern natriuretic peptide/NO-cGMP signaling that lowers systemic and pulmonary pressure, inhibits vasoconstriction and increases renal sodium and water excretion, unlike smooth-muscle contraction, renin-angiotensin or generic cyclic-nucleotide-response confusables.

qualifier: proline synthesis and catabolism
name: Glutamate-family amino acid metabolism centred on proline
rationale: Specific members are proline biosynthesis and catabolism, with the remaining generic amino acid metabolism terms; confusables instead centre on glutamate/glutamine, glycine/glyoxylate or serine metabolism.

qualifier: gap junction electrical coupling and negative regulation of rate and contraction
name: Cardiac gap junction coupling and negative regulation of contraction
rationale: Members regulate cardiac conduction through gap-junction coupling, membrane potential, T-tubule-dependent calcium release and dampening of heart rate and contraction, unlike confusables focused on calcium handling that increases force, cardiomyocyte adhesion or action-potential ion channels.

qualifier: phosphatidic acid to MAG/DAG/TAG plus lysophospholipid hydrolysis
name: Phosphatidic acid to DAG/TAG synthesis and lysophospholipid hydrolysis
rationale: Members cover phosphatidic acid synthesis and its conversion to mono-, di- and triacylglycerols together with LPC/LPE hydrolysis, distinguishing it from glycerol metabolism, phosphatidylcholine synthesis, phospholipid acyl-chain remodeling and triglyceride catabolism confusables.

qualifier: CYP/FMO oxidation and methylation, acetylation, sulfonation of toxins and plant compounds
name: Xenobiotic and natural product detoxification by CYP/FMO and conjugation
rationale: Members are phase I (CYP1A2, CYP2E1, FMO) and phase II (methylation, acetylation, sulfonation) metabolism of drugs, toxins and plant-derived compounds, unlike the confusables built around specific drug ADME/glycine conjugation, glycoside transport or ethanol/aldehyde oxidation.

core: mRNA 3'-end processing and translation-termination quality control
qualifier: nonsense- and non-stop-mediated decay
name: mRNA polyadenylation and termination-coupled nonsense and non-stop decay
rationale: Members link mRNA cleavage/polyadenylation and intronless mRNA processing with translation termination and the NMD and non-stop decay pathways that monitor it, distinguishing it from confusables about histone mRNA processing, deadenylation/decapping decay, splicing or no-go decay.

qualifier: mammary gland and placental trophoblast in pregnancy
name: Mammary gland and placental trophoblast development in pregnancy
rationale: Members cover mammary lineage differentiation, branching, lactation and involution together with trophoblast, labyrinth, decidual and early embryonic development of pregnancy, distinct from prostate/genital-tract, germline stem cell and male gonad confusables.

qualifier: BH3-only/BCL-2 control of permeabilization through apoptosome activation
name: BCL-2 family-regulated mitochondrial apoptosis and apoptosome caspase activation
rationale: Members span BH3-only protein activation, BCL-2-family control of outer membrane permeabilization and cytochrome c release, and apoptosome/SMAC-mediated caspase activation, unlike confusables on oxidative-stress triggers, execution-phase DNA fragmentation, extrinsic/necroptotic signaling or p53 transcription.

qualifier: tetrahydrofolate interconversion and folate transport
name: Folate and tetrahydrofolate one-carbon metabolism and transport
rationale: Members all concern folate/pterin metabolism, tetrahydrofolate and formyl-THF interconversion, formate and folate transport, whereas confusables are methionine/SAM cycle or de novo nucleotide synthesis.

qualifier: during DNA replication and repair, with ADP-ribosylation reversal
name: Nucleosome assembly and remodeling during DNA replication and repair
rationale: Members concern nucleosome assembly/disassembly and CHD1/2 remodeling coupled to DNA replication, excision repair and damage-induced telomere maintenance, including de-ADP-ribosylation and deubiquitination, unlike transcription-linked remodeler/histone methylation confusables or DSB-repair localization.

core: Translation machinery biogenesis and RNA modification
qualifier: mitochondrial gene expression plus tRNA, rRNA and translation-factor modification
name: Mitochondrial gene expression and tRNA, rRNA, translation-factor modification
rationale: Members cover mtDNA replication, mitochondrial transcription, RNA processing and translation together with tRNA/rRNA modification, aminoacylation and translation-factor modifications (hypusine, diphthamide) serving translational fidelity, distinct from Pol I/III transcription and splicing, mRNA decay, protein methylation and Cajal body confusables.

core: Protein localization to the cell surface
qualifier: apical surface and plasma membrane rafts
name: Protein targeting to apical surface and membrane rafts
rationale: Members concern regulation of protein delivery to the cell surface, specifically apical surface and lipid raft localization, with GTPase activation; confusables instead emphasise basolateral secretion, Golgi-to-membrane transport, CFTR trafficking or specific Rho GTPase cycles.

qualifier: fructose 2,6-bisphosphate control balancing glycolysis and pentose phosphate shunt
name: Fructose 2,6-bisphosphate control of glycolysis versus pentose phosphate shunt
rationale: Members concern fructose 2,6- and 1,6-bisphosphate metabolism regulating glycolytic versus pentose-phosphate flux, unlike confusables centred on fermentation/lactate production, hexokinase or mTORC1/p53 metabolic programmes.

qualifier: ADAR editing and PKR restraint of interferon signaling
name: ADAR editing, PKR and AU-rich mRNA stability control
rationale: Members combine HuR/AUF1 3'-UTR mRNA stability, translational silencing and mRNA localization with ADAR A-to-I editing, PKR signaling and negative regulation of type I interferon, distinguishing it from TTP/KSRP/stress-granule and OAS antiviral confusables.

qualifier: with mitochondrial fission-fusion and protein localization control
name: Organelle-selective autophagy with mitochondrial fission-fusion control
rationale: Members cover mitophagy, pexophagy, reticulophagy and nucleophagy, phagophore cargo targeting and the mitochondrial dynamics and localization events that prime mitophagy, unlike confusables on mitochondrial protein import, aggrephagy/CMA or autophagosome-lysosome fusion.

qualifier: glycine/glutamine conjugation of aromatic acids
name: Drug ADME and glycine/glutamine conjugation of aromatic acids
rationale: Members are absorption-metabolism-excretion routes for specific drugs (aspirin, paracetamol, atorvastatin, prednisone, ciprofloxacin) and mitochondrial amino-acid conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate, distinguishing it from broader CYP/FMO/sulfonation xenobiotic confusables.

qualifier: lipid droplet formation, fusion, lipophagy and adipocyte context
name: Lipid droplet formation, lipophagy and adipocyte triglyceride storage
rationale: Members regulate lipid droplet biogenesis, fusion and disassembly, lipophagy and the balance of triglyceride storage versus lipolysis in adipocytes, unlike confusables on fatty-acid transport, LXR-driven lipogenesis or glycerolipid synthesis enzymology.
